title: Railway To Heaven
summary: Is crude by rail making a comeback in North America? Large oceangoing tankers are generally considered the most cost-efficient way to move crude oil over long distances across the world. Pipelines are a quick, reliable and cost effective alternative although by their nature, they are less flexible.
